summary: Password Reset feature testing complete. All 20 backend tests passed. All UI components verified via Playwright: Login page 'Forgot Password?' link, Forgot Password page (email/CAPID form), Reset Password page (valid/invalid token handling), and Profile page Change Password section.
seed_data_creation: Test user exists (created by main agent)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset feature fully implemented and tested. Both self-service (forgot password) and profile change password flows work correctly. SendGrid returns debug_token when not fully configured - can be used for testing. Token expiry is 1 hour.

verified_features.feature: Forgot Password link on login page
verified_features.details: Link visible with data-testid='forgot-password-link', navigates to /forgot-password

verified_features.feature: Forgot Password page requires email and CAPID
verified_features.details: Form shows EMAIL ADDRESS and CAPID (SECURITY VERIFICATION) fields with proper data-testid attributes

verified_features.feature: Forgot Password API returns debug token
verified_features.details: POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns debug_token when SendGrid not configured. Token is UUID format.
Invalid token shows 'Invalid or Expired Link' message with 'Request New Reset Link' button

verified_features.feature: Reset Password page shows form for valid token
verified_features.details: Valid token shows 'Create New Password' form with email displayed, new password and confirm password fields
API returns 400 error for passwords under 6 characters

verified_features.feature: Profile page has Change Password section
verified_features.details: CHANGE PASSWORD section with expandable form using data-testid='show-change-password-btn'

verified_features.feature: Profile Change Password requires current password
verified_features.details: API validates current password, returns 400 'Current password is incorrect' if wrong
Form has CONFIRM NEW PASSWORD field, frontend validates match before submission
POST /api/profile/change-password returns 'Password changed successfully', user can login with new password

verified_features.feature: User can login with new password after reset
verified_features.details: Both self-service reset and profile change password allow subsequent login with new password

test_classes: TestForgotPasswordAPI - 4 tests: valid email/CAPID, wrong CAPID, nonexistent email, debug token
TestVerifyResetTokenAPI - 2 tests: valid token, invalid token
TestResetPasswordAPI - 3 tests: valid token, invalid token, short password
TestAdminResetPasswordAPI - 4 tests: auth required, success, short password, nonexistent user
TestFullPasswordResetFlow - 2 tests: complete flow, token invalidation after use
TestProfileChangePassword - 5 tests: auth required, wrong current pwd, short pwd, success, old pwd invalidated

ui_tests.login_page: Forgot Password link visible and clickable
ui_tests.forgot_password_page: Email and CAPID inputs, Send Reset Link button, success message after submit
ui_tests.reset_password_invalid: Shows error for invalid/expired tokens with Request New Reset Link option
ui_tests.reset_password_valid: Shows Create New Password form with user email, password fields, Reset Password button
ui_tests.profile_change_password: Expandable form with Current Password, New Password (min 6 chars), Confirm Password, Cancel/Update buttons
